Answer: Centenary Bank offers deposit, savings, credit/loan and advances, and money transfer services, tailored for Government, SMEs, Corporate, and Individual customers, delivered through different channels based on customer needs.

sources.doc_title: Who are Centenary Bank?
sources.text: Question: Who are Centenary Bank? Answer: Centenary Bank's history dates back to 1983 when it started as a credit trust of the Uganda National Lay Apostolate. Operations started in 1985 with two main purposes: serving the rural poor and contributing to Uganda's socio-economic development. In 1993, it transitioned to Centenary Rural Development Bank Limited and was licensed as a full-service commercial bank. Today it is Uganda's leading Microfinance Bank with an asset base of UGX 8.496 trillion, serving 3 million customers through 83 branches, 219 ATMs, over 8,758 Agents, and digital channels including CenteMobile, CenteOnline banking, CenteVisa debit & prepaid cards, and Mastercard Platinum debit card. Vision: 'To be the best provider of Financial Services, especially Microfinance.'

sources.doc_title: What are the requirements for obtaining a Visa Card replacement?
sources.text: Question: What are the requirements for obtaining a Visa Card replacement? Answer: Call the toll-free lines 0800200555 (MTN) or 0800335344 (Airtel) to block the lost card, then visit any branch with your National ID for a replacement at UGX 15,000. Turnaround time is same day.

sources.doc_title: What are the requirements for obtaining a Visa card?
sources.text: Question: What are the requirements for obtaining a Visa card? Answer: Visit a branch with a National ID; the card costs UGX 15,000 and is instantly issued and activated.

sources.doc_title: Why does my money keep getting deducted at the end of the month?
sources.text: Question: Why does my money keep getting deducted at the end of the month? Answer: Standard charges: UGX 3,000 ledger fee for savings accounts; UGX 11,000 for current accounts; UGX 10,000 annual Visa card fee. Each bank charge attracts 15% excise duty. If a deduction isn't among these, call the toll-free lines 0800200555 (MTN) or 0800335344 (Airtel).

sources.doc_title: What are the requirements for opening a savings account with Centenary Bank?
sources.text: Question: What are the requirements for opening a savings account with Centenary Bank? Answer: Have a valid original National ID and registered mobile number, then download the CenteMobile App, click CenteOn the Go, choose the preferred account, and follow the prompts. Alternatively, visit any branch with: two passport-size photos; a valid ID (copy of National ID); an initial opening cash deposit of UGX 10,000 (plus UGX 15,000 for a new Visa card).

sources.doc_title: Who are Centenary Bank?
sources.text: Question: Who are Centenary Bank? Answer: Centenary Bank's history dates back to 1983 when it started as a credit trust of the Uganda National Lay Apostolate. Operations started in 1985 with two main purposes: serving the rural poor and contributing to Uganda's socio-economic development. In 1993, it transitioned to Centenary Rural Development Bank Limited and was licensed as a full-service commercial bank. Today it is Uganda's leading Microfinance Bank with an asset base of UGX 8.496 trillion, serving 3 million customers through 83 branches, 219 ATMs, over 8,758 Agents, and digital channels including CenteMobile, CenteOnline banking, CenteVisa debit & prepaid cards, and Mastercard Platinum debit card. Vision: 'To be the best provider of Financial Services, especially Microfinance.'

sources.doc_title: What services and products does Centenary Bank offer?
sources.text: Question: What services and products does Centenary Bank offer? Answer: Centenary Bank offers deposit, savings, credit/loan and advances, and money transfer services, tailored for Government, SMEs, Corporate, and Individual customers, delivered through different channels based on customer needs.

sources.doc_title: Where is Centenary Bank's Head Office located?
sources.text: Question: Where is Centenary Bank's Head Office located? Answer: Mapeera House, Plot 44-46 Kampala Road & 2 Burton Street, Kampala City.
